description: This Java class 'UpdateDeliveryPerson' is a servlet that handles POST requests for updating delivery person's details, including profile image, email, phone, password, vehicle number, and city in an online grocery ordering system.

classes.name: UpdateDeliveryPerson
classes.description: Servlet class for processing delivery person profile update requests, including image upload and profile data update.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update delivery person details, including image and contact information, and forwards or redirects based on success.
